summary: On June 8, 2026, Brookfield Private Equity Fund LP filed an 8-K reporting the sale of unregistered limited partnership units (Class S, I, B-2) for aggregate consideration of approximately $8.085 million under its continuous private offering, exempt via Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The filing also discloses the Fund's Transactional NAV per unit as of April 30, 2026, for various classes. This is a routine capital-raising activity by a private fund; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or liquidation, and there is no forced management change. The filing constitutes an ordinary current report with no special-situation event.
